false_success_traps: A submitted request is not proof. In one run the listing was still showing at the first recheck. Always check again.
If the final "request submitted" message does not appear, the automation records a failure. A page that just reloads or stays on the form is not a confirmation.
The "email has been successfully verified" message only confirms the email address. The form still has to be submitted.
Use the current Privacy Request Form. An older privacy-law request page was found to be stale.
genuine_confirmation: After you submit, the form says "request submitted" or that your opt-out / deletion request has been submitted. Without that final message, the request does not count as made.
name: MyLife

opt_out_url_check.note: A plain web request got a "you have been blocked" security page (HTTP 403), not the form. A real browser may still load it.

steps: Have the link to your own listing ready. A link to a page of search results will not work.
Open the Privacy Request Form page. A security check may appear first. A person must clear it.
The form is for deletion and opt out of sale of personal information. Choose your state.
On the opt-out form, fill in first name, last name, city, ZIP code, and birth year. Paste the link to your listing.
Enter your email address and press Verify Email. MyLife sends a code to that address.
Enter the code. Wait until the form says the email has been successfully verified.
Solve the reCAPTCHA and submit the form.
Wait for the message that the request was submitted.
